module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: a 3-state FSM loads operands, accumulates shifted multiplicand over 16 cycles, then pulses done.

anchors.name: m
anchors.why: Idle/Run/Finish state register sequencing operand load, 16 accumulate cycles and done pulse.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input; in idle it loads operands and launches the multiply.

anchors.name: acc
anchors.why: Partial-product accumulator held across the 16-cycle operation; drives product output p.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: One-cycle done pulse in Finish state signalling product p is valid.

anchors.name: t
anchors.why: Adder result acc+x when multiplier LSB is set, next accumulator value.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: Multiplicand latched from a, shifted left each run cycle.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: Multiplier latched from b, shifted right; LSB gates the add.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Iteration counter of run cycles; reaching 16 ends the multiply.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand input loaded into x on start.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Multiplier operand input loaded into y on start.

anchors.name: bz
anchors.why: Busy level decoded from FSM being in Run state.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Terminal-count flag k==16 moving FSM from Run to Finish.

groups.name: Multiply controller
groups.description: FSM sequencing load, iterate and done pulse; outputs busy and done.

groups.name: Shift-add datapath
groups.description: Shifting multiplicand/multiplier registers and conditional adder into accumulator driving p.

groups.name: Iteration counter
groups.description: Counts 16 run cycles for the FSM.
